learning_outcomes.text: The students are able to give an enhanced overview over the following topics in metals, polymers and ceramics: Atomic bonds, crystal and amorphous structures, defects , electrical and mass transport, microstructure and phase diagrams. They are capable to explain the corresponding technical terms.
The students are able to apply the appropriate physical and (electro-)chemical methods for the above mentioned subjects.
Students can provide appropriate feedback and handle feedback on their own performance constructively.
The students are capable to understand independently the structure and properties of ceramics, metals and polymers. They should be able to critically evaluate the profoundness of their knowledge.
